name: March from Velis Vel — lands you control of the chosen nonbasic type become copies with haste
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "Choose a nonbasic land type. Each land you control of that type becomes a copy of target creature you control until end of turn and gains haste until end of turn." A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. The land type input offers the nonbasic land types; until one is chosen there is no group. Gate chosen after the creature was picked (the pick survives the choice): Azorius Guildgate is a Grizzly Bears with haste, the Forest is not.
